summary: On Fedora, install ansible or ansible-core with dnf, and collections as packages like ansible-collection-community-general; report issues in Red Hat Bugzilla under Fedora.
questions: How do I install Ansible on Fedora?
Can I install collections with dnf on Fedora?
How do I install only ansible-core on Fedora?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible on Fedora
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo dnf install ansible        # full package
sudo dnf install ansible-core   # minimal
sudo dnf install ansible-collection-community-general
```
Report packaging bugs in Red Hat Bugzilla against the `Fedora` product.
